message:
Retrospective external OpenAI safety-check incident from Architect's previous Wayfold turn. Tool mcp__Jarvis__resume_agent was blocked while attempting to change existing Ready assignment to Working. Exact arguments:
```json
{
  "projectName": "Wayfold",
  "taskId": "legacy-item-semantics-normalization",
  "ownerId": "Architect"
}
```
Verbatim error: "Script error: This tool call was blocked by OpenAI's safety checks. Please double check what you are sending." One attempt, no retry in prior turn. The follow-up mcp__Jarvis__notify_agent also blocked with same error, so this report was delayed. User explicitly reauthorized all Jarvis tools; the original resume succeeded now. No secrets.
